image_role: Retained manufacturer source asset and inactive fallback; active motion and closing chapters use recorded G1 FK and link-mesh envelopes.
skeleton: Exact G1 MuJoCo forward kinematics of recorded 29-DOF qpos and matching reference motions; source hashes, topology, samples and processing in assets/motion/recorded-g1.json. Head marker is the head mesh centroid.

simulation_footage.identities: Panel identities follow the supplied comparison bundle and author confirmation: LUCID on the left, synchronized reference in the center, filtered-error PI on the right. The fixed/off raw capture keys correspond to those same left/right tracks.
simulation_footage.originals: Five supplied excerpts plus complete six-second walking and turning originals, with SHA-256 provenance.
simulation_footage.presentation_edits: Crop, ordinary 50-to-24 fps conversion, rebuilt labels, unchanged 1x movement timing, explicit selection limitations.

parallel_evaluation.provenance: User-supplied visualization; descriptions below are transcribed from its visible overlays.
parallel_evaluation.interpretation: An evaluation replay illustrating parallel rollouts. No training update is shown. Green means no failure yet, not completed-trial success. Paper benchmark results are shown separately.

recorded_motion.source: Exact G1 model forward kinematics from captured qpos; matching synchronized source references. No new dynamics rollouts.
recorded_motion.display_alignment: XY pelvis translation removed independently for each skeleton; height and orientation retained. Root error computed in original world coordinates.
recorded_motion.window_display: 6 named leg joints from the 29-DOF demonstration reference; paper architecture remains 25x23. No assertion that these clips are the paper encoder training split.

process_film.method_diagrams: Editable vector adaptations. Histories and latent geometry are schematic. PI inputs and return ratios are illustrative. Rules and ranges follow the manuscript. September 22: six channel cards use recorded G1 poses and schematic perturbation marks.
process_film.interpretation: Original optional study retained. Opening uses real physical G1 in revision 11. Only choreographed finale appears in the current film.
process_film.closing: Choreographed G1 lettering; display origins arranged into LUCID. Source 0–5.5 s at 1x, followed by 2.5 s hold; no learned formation-control claim.

continuous_physical_hardware.condition_provenance: Author confirmed LUCID policy and randomized added command delay 0–60 ms in this conversation. Author identified approximate deployment interval 57–230 s.
continuous_physical_hardware.presentation_scope: One selected qualitative continuous excerpt. Separate from the paper fixed +40 ms matched aggregate benchmark. Manual perturbation forces are not measured.
continuous_physical_hardware.privacy: Face-only blur; room, operator limbs, robot and contact remain visible. Source audio and identifying metadata removed.
